knownDefects.defect: A score far below the Recruit anchor still returns Recruit
knownDefects.why: rank() seeds the answer with floorTier = 'Recruit' and only ever raises it, so anything scoring under the Recruit anchor (334.8) is reported as Recruit instead of Untrained.
knownDefects.resolution: Not fixed: it was not one of the approved Prompt 3 changes. This input no longer reaches the engine at all (one lift out of three), so the defect is now demonstrated by chest-open-floor-tier-below-recruit instead.

knownDefects.defect: Unbounded reps let a trivial weight outrank a heavy bench
knownDefects.why: incline_db scores weight * reps * 1.1 with no rep cap, so 100 reps of a 15 lb dumbbell outscores the Celestial anchor, whose bench is 315 lb.
knownDefects.resolution: Reduced, not closed. Reps are now capped at 30, so this input is refused, but volume is still linear in reps up to the cap: see chest-open-rep-cap-does-not-close-volume. Closing it means changing the formulas, which would move every tier and was out of scope.

knownDefects.defect: The Primordial override ignores the score entirely
knownDefects.why: A single bench rep at 415 lb promotes to Primordial even though the resulting score sits below the Warrior anchor (708.3999999999999).
knownDefects.resolution: Fixed: the override rule is deleted, so Primordial is earned by score (2491.6) like every other tier. This input is also refused now, because a bench alone is not a chest lift set.

knownDefects.why: Nothing rejects physically impossible input, so a 99999 lb bench for 99 reps is scored and stored rather than refused.
knownDefects.resolution: Fixed: every lift carries weight and rep bounds, and this input breaks both.

knownDefects.defect: Chest anchor scores are not strictly increasing
knownDefects.why: The v1 Primordial anchor (bench 405x1, incline_db 115x4, cable 55x10) scored 1703.4, below Immortal's 2253.2, and the ladder hid it by excluding the tier the override owned.
knownDefects.resolution: Fixed: the anchor is now bench 415x4, incline_db 115x8, cable 55x12, scoring 2491.6. Startup validation would now refuse the old value. NOTE: this entry's lifts are the anchor itself, so its input differs from v1.

knownDefects.defect: Back repeats the chest override defect
knownDefects.why: A 600 lb deadlift single promotes to Primordial at a score below back's own Recruit anchor (962.25).
knownDefects.resolution: Fixed: the override is deleted. Back's Primordial anchor already scored 5826, above Immortal's 5501.4, so no anchor had to move.

knownDefects.defect: A complete but very light set is still reported as Recruit
knownDefects.why: The same floorTier defect as above, now shown with valid input: a set this light scores far under the Recruit anchor (334.8) and is still called Recruit rather than Untrained.
knownDefects.resolution: Open. Not an approved Prompt 3 change.

knownDefects.defect: The rep cap reduces the volume exploit but does not close it
knownDefects.why: Every weight here is the Heroic anchor's, but claimed for 30 reps instead of 8 or 12. Heroic scores 939.5999999999999; this reaches Primordial, because volume is linear in reps all the way to the cap.
knownDefects.resolution: Open by decision: closing it means changing the formulas, which would move every tier. The cap only removes the absurd inputs above 30 reps.

knownDefects.defect: Back has the same residual volume exploit
knownDefects.why: Heroic-anchor weights (Heroic scores 2887.35) claimed for 30 reps each reach Primordial, and back leans on volume harder than chest does: its lat_pulldown factor is 1.6.
knownDefects.resolution: Open by decision, for the same reason as chest's.
